features.featureTitle: Replace ALL service card images across all 48+ services with real professional photos showing actual technicians performing services. Specifically replace: AC Installation (blank/missing image), AC Gas Refill, Tap Repair (broken image), Furniture Repair (cartoon workshop illustration), Door & Window Fixing (cartoon diagram with multiple panels), and all other services with cartoon illustrations, blank images, or broken placeholders. Use realistic, high-quality photos with proper cropping (object-fit: cover), rounded corners matching card design. Do NOT use cartoons, illustrations, icons, or placeholders.

Fix search bar functionality in the navigation menu to filter services in real-time as the user types. Display filtered results in a dropdown below the search input showing matching service names, categories, and descriptions. Clicking a search result should navigate to that specific service on the Services page or scroll to the service card.

Fix mobile dropdown scrolling issues for service category filter buttons and all service dropdowns throughout the application. Apply max-height: 260px, overflow-y: auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, overscroll-behavior: contain, and z-index: 9999 to enable smooth scrolling within dropdowns. Prevent page body scroll when a dropdown is open on mobile devices. Ensure dropdown remains open while scrolling its contents.

Generate professional service photos for frontend/public/assets/generated/ directory covering all services that currently have missing, broken, or cartoon images. Include realistic photos of: AC installation technician mounting unit, AC gas refill service in progress, tap repair plumber fixing faucet, furniture repair technician working on damaged furniture, door and window fixing carpenter installing door frame, and all other services identified from the uploaded screenshots as needing real photos. Integrate these generated images into the respective service cards.
